files.milkyway_dust.webp: 2048 x 2048, one channel (R = G = B): 0 clear, 255 darkest lane; derived here from the picture's own dark, reddish lanes, not from a dust survey

frame.centre: Galactic centre at the image centre (u, v) = (0.5, 0.5)
frame.longitude0: up (-v) from the Sun; l = 90 to the left (-u)
frame.accuracy: scale and Sun position measured from PIA10748 fig 1, about 3%

nature: artist's concept based on Spitzer data, not an image
terms: JPL image use policy: free to use with credit
